name: The Weft of Rain
prompt: Stretch a single horizontal loom between two low brick sheds. Fine blue water jets form the warp, and a little brass shuttle pulls vermilion yarn across them. At the far end, finished cloth hangs dripping above a collecting trough.

name: The Dye Stair
prompt: Set six broad shallow dye baths in a descending zigzag. A pale bolt of fabric dips through each, gathering bands of colour. Workers peg the finished train of cloth onto an open staircase that becomes the neighbourhood's evening promenade.

name: A Mill for Shadows
prompt: Stretch white linen sails at sharp angles around a central rack of cut-metal shapes. Operators rotate the shapes to cast silhouettes; dyers trace their outlines onto the cloth. One sail bears an enormous unfinished silhouette of a flying swallow.

name: The Bobbin Borough
prompt: Stand a family of giant wooden bobbins upright like short round houses. Their outer layers unwind into elevated walkways between homes. Women at treadles rewind the oldest, faded paths into striped cloth at ground level.

name: The Carpet River
prompt: Send a continuous length of moss-green carpet down a meandering line of low rollers. Children ferry spools across on little footbridges. At one end an enormous roll is cut into small islands of carpet for nearby homes.
